text: Toronto and East York Community Council will introduce bills.

General Bills Toronto and East York Community Council passed By-laws 1295-2024 to 1317-2024, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bill Toronto and East York Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 1318-2024, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
